items.note: Agent assumes trapped propane via leaking gates over 16 months but does not establish at least 65 vol% full or lack of detection instrumentation.
Agent identifies heating blocked-in liquid propane by hot quench causing hydraulic expansion to about 6260 psig, well above 300 psig MAWP and 450 psig hydrotest.
Agent states the 2001 gate valves isolated each reboiler from the sole fractionator-top PRV, leaving a closed standby shell with no relief path.
Agent covers deficient 2001 MOC/PHA and missing switching/layup procedures but omits poor PSSR, failed PHA action-item closure, and the supervisor's unassessed manipulation.
Agent lists a dedicated PSV on each reboiler but recommends car-seal/lock-open interlocks instead and omits positive isolation with blinds.
Agent recommends MOC/PHA, procedures, training and PSM audit improvements but omits safety-culture assessments, process-safety metrics, and the API 521 standby-equipment definition change.
